DRIVE 1/6

Play
Normal
PRIMARY
Quads, Glutes
SECONDARY
Chest, Front Delts, Biceps, Calves

Instructions

Preparation: Set the seat so your leg is almost straight at the bottom. Hold the moving handles and put both feet on the pedals.

1

Drive down through your whole foot.

2

Push and pull the handles while pedalling.

3

Keep both legs turning; no dead spots.

4

Sit tall; keep your hips seated.

5

Breathe in rhythm; never hold your breath.

6

Hold a pace you can sustain.

STEP 1/6

Play
Normal
PRIMARY
Glutes
SECONDARY
Hamstrings, Calves

Instructions

Preparation: Step on and start at a slow, steady pace. Rest your hands lightly on the side rails.

1

Stand tall; shoulders stacked over hips.

2

Drive the whole foot down each step.

3

Bring the other knee through to climb.

4

Keep a light grip on the rails.

5

Land the whole foot on the step.

6

Hold a pace you can sustain.

CATCH 1/6

Play
Normal
PRIMARY
Quads, Upper Back
SECONDARY
Hamstrings, Biceps

Instructions

Preparation: Strap in, grip the handle, start compressed with shins vertical.

1

Compress with straight arms and vertical shins.

2

Push with your legs; keep arms straight.

3

Lean back slightly; draw handle below ribs.

4

Stay supported; keep wrists and shoulders relaxed.

5

Arms away, then hinge forward before sliding.

6

Recover twice as slowly as you drive.

Watch out

If you're yanking the handle with your arms first, you're wasting the big engine. Legs, back, arms — in that order.

Registered guide: caption and cue above
